_about: Per-plane VR cockpit data, read once per VR session by src/Flight/Hud/VrCockpits.cs and applied only while a headset (or the --xr-sim stand-in) draws the interior; a flat launch never reads it. interiorScaleFactor multiplies the cockpit1 mount's scale (PlaneBuilder.InteriorScale, 0.04 m per interior unit). eyeOffsetZ moves the seated eye in metres along the mount's own Z axis, positive aft, the one axis that keeps the gunsight on the guns. A plane left out, or a field left out, takes 1.0 and 0.0. Every plane ships at those defaults until it is judged at the headset; the _proposed notes are the measured starting points to try. Fields and ranges: docs/architecture/Flight.md, src/Flight/Hud/VrCockpits.cs.

player_warhawk._proposed: eyeOffsetZ 0.06: the dials sit 0.32 m from the eye, under the 0.33 m reach floor; 6 cm aft gives 0.37 m and leaves 0.21 m to the head plate at 0.27 m behind the eye, which VR leaves out.

player_autogyro._proposed: an open tub 1.57 m wide; try interiorScaleFactor 0.875 (0.035 m per unit) first if it reads big.

player_avenger._proposed: the lowest median of the four cues; try interiorScaleFactor 0.875 first if it reads big.

player_balmoral._proposed: a tub 1.44 m wide; try interiorScaleFactor 0.875 first. Its interior wings read at half the hull's span at any scale.
